y_failures: Calls the son-in-law 'Augustus Kuffler' (Jaeger pp. 89 and 13 name Abraham Kuffler); describes the regulated furnace as 'a circulation oven about two feet square', but p. 90 uses that phrase for the bread ovens.
reason: Both answers explain the mercury-and-lever regulator and name Monconys, Kuffler and Boyle, but Y gets Kuffler's name wrong and mixes up the furnace with the bread ovens. X stays close to Jaeger's pages, although it leaves out the air-expansion retort described on p. 88.
